description: This file defines the MAX_Dal_Entities class, a data access layer class for retrieving ad and channel entity data, including ad details, delivery limitations for ads and channels, from the database.

classes.name: MAX_Dal_Entities
classes.description: Data access layer class for retrieving ad and channel entity data, extending MAX_Dal_Common.

methods.name: getAdsByCampaignId
methods.description: Retrieves all ads associated with a specific campaign ID, returning an array of ad details or null/error.

methods.name: getDeliveryLimitationsByAdId
methods.description: Retrieves delivery limitations for a specific ad ID, returning an array indexed by execution order or null/error.

methods.name: getDeliveryLimitationsByChannelId
methods.description: Retrieves delivery limitations for a specific channel ID, returning an array indexed by execution order or null/error.
